questions.q: What happens to a report's format the moment you group its rows by a field?
options: Nothing changes until you manually pick Summary
It switches from Tabular to Summary automatically
It switches to Matrix automatically
It becomes a Joined report
questions.explain: In Lightning Experience, grouping rows is what makes a report a summary report. The format updates itself the moment you add a row grouping; you don't choose the format first.

questions.q: How do you group a date field by Calendar Quarter instead of by exact day?
options: Add a bucket column to the date field
Right-click the date column and choose Group Date By, then pick a grain
Switch the report format to Matrix
Add a row-level formula
questions.explain: Date columns have their own grouping menu, reached by right-clicking the column: Group Date By offers Day, Calendar Week, Calendar Month, Calendar Quarter, Calendar Year, and more.

questions.q: A report is grouped by Stage, with 15 opportunity rows and a Unique Count of 7 under Account Name. What does the 7 represent?
options: The number of distinct accounts among those 15 opportunities
The number of opportunities still open
The number of sales reps who own those opportunities
A typo; Unique Count should equal the row count
questions.explain: Unique Count counts distinct values in a column, not rows. Fifteen opportunity rows can easily belong to only seven different accounts if some accounts have multiple opportunities.

questions.q: What does adding a second row-level grouping field produce?
options: A joined report with two blocks
A chart with two series
Nested groups, each with its own subtotal inside the outer group
A duplicate of the first grouping
questions.explain: A second grouping field nests inside the first, so each outer group is broken into its own set of subtotaled subgroups — year, then month within each year, for example.

questions.q: Where does the overall total for every group in a summary report appear?
options: At the top of the report, above all groups
In the Grand Total row at the bottom
It doesn't appear unless you add a summary formula
In the Fields pane
questions.explain: The Grand Total row rolls every group's subtotal into a single total for the whole report, shown at the bottom (and can be toggled on or off in the report footer).
